name: Save the Last Dance
source:
A single dance. But the outcome has yet to be determined. Will you do what must be done to escape with your life? Or wind up dead on the floor when the curtain falls? Control your tongue and you might live to see another day. Don't and this may truly be your...

...final dance.

[from [url=https://carrotpatchgames.itch.io/save-the-last-dance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一支单独的舞蹈。但结果尚未确定。你会做必须做的事情来逃脱你的生命吗？或者当窗帘落下时死在地板上？控制住你的舌头，你可能会活到另一天。不要，这可能真的是你的…

…最后的舞蹈。

[来自[url=https://carrotpatchgames.itch.io/save-the-last-dance]itch.io[/url]]
